title: Detection Is Cheap, Routing Is Learned: Why Refusal-Based Alignment Evaluation Fails

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to Chinese Communist Party (CCP)-sensitive prompts versus structurally matched Western controls by measuring refusal rates and narrative steering scores using an LLM judge, alongside internal methods like linear probing and activation ablation.
Comparing model refusal rates and censorship strategies on identical political prompts submitted in English versus Chinese to identify language-conditioned routing and policy behavior.
A preliminary proof-of-concept test extracting a conceptual representation direction using 8 gender-stereotyped and 8 neutral prompts, followed by ablation to observe potential behavioral changes.
